newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's FinMin repeats not worried about soft skr.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's FinMin repeats not worried about soft skr.

text.p: Sweden's Finance Minister Erik Asbrink reiterated on Friday that he was not particularly worried about the soft crown.
"I have really insufficient information about what has happened to the crown, but I am not particularly worried," Asbrink said.
Asbrink said it was an exaggeration to describe the crown's softening to a TCW index of more than 123 as a sharp fall. Such TCW crown levels have not been seen since October 1995.
The crown's softening accelerated on Friday as foreign funds sold the unit, dealers said.
At 1245 GMT, the crown was changing hands at 4.5590 against the mark, up from 4.5015 late on Thursday.
In September 1996, the crown traded around 4.4133 to the mark.
Asbrink also dismissed worries about the softening crown earlier on Friday, before its latest dip.
